attributes.name: Odeenka
attributes.powers:
Odeenka is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. You may succeed at a Charisma or Diplomacy 14 check to evade Odeenka.

Before you act, each character at your location is dealt 1d6 Combat damage; the difficulty of the checks to defeat Odeenka is increased by your result.
